title: Medicines management
summary: Medicines support from start to finish: assessments, MAR records, errors, carer competency and audits.
whenToUse: Every quarter, after a medication error, or when eMAR shows gaps or late doses.

statements.focus: Medication errors and near misses: were they reported, investigated and learned from?
Medication training and yearly competency checks for every carer who gives medicines.
Consent and capacity for medicines support, including covert medicines.
Medicines audits: how often, what they found and whether actions were finished.
